event.title: Harvey Weinstein Receives 15-Year Sentence for Sexual Assault
event.canonical_title: Harvey Weinstein Receives 15-Year Sentence for Sexual Assault
event.summary: Harvey Weinstein has been sentenced to 15 years in prison for sexually assaulting Miriam Haley in 2006. This sentencing follows a lengthy legal process that included a retrial, where a jury found him guilty of the charges. The sentencing took place in New York.

timeline.title: Harvey Weinstein Receives 15-Year Sentence for Sexual Assault
timeline.summary: Harvey Weinstein has been sentenced to 15 years in prison for a sexual assault that occurred in 2006. The sentencing comes after survivor Miriam Haley spoke about the lasting impact the assault has had on her life and sense of security.
